subject: vt-u-p
title: (R)VT.U.P.------pol.dy.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 169 (UPB(II)-31). VT-U-P is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The title names POL-DY (political dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), POL-DYM (political dynamics), LANG-DY (language dynamics) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROG-CONT: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From LANG-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From PROJ-DY: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). From INFO-DE-B: MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From MTA-RT-SIGN: PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies).
